// Intelligibility Analyzer
// generated by scripts/gen/gen_intelligibility.py; edit the generator.
//
// Estimates how intelligible a speech stem is inside a full mix.  The mix
// passes through unchanged, so the node can sit inline on a mix bus.
//
// Inputs
// ------
//   speech  the isolated dialogue, before any effects
//   mix     the full mix containing that dialogue plus effects, music, sfx
//
// Method
// ------
// Both inputs are split into 18 one-third-octave bands (160 Hz to
// 8000 Hz).  Each band's block RMS is its envelope.  Over a sliding
// window, per band:
//
//   envelope correlation  how closely the mix envelope follows the speech
//                         envelope (the idea behind STOI).  Masking noise,
//                         music and reverb tails all pull it down; a gain
//                         change on the speech does not.
//   audibility            the speech-to-noise ratio mapped as in the Speech
//                         Intelligibility Index, (SNR + 15) / 30 clamped to
//                         [0, 1].  Noise power is mix power minus speech
//                         power, so set `speech_gain_db` if the dialogue sits
//                         in the mix at a different level than the speech
//                         input.
//
// Both are summed across bands with the ANSI S3.5 band-importance weights.
// The statistics hold while the speech input is silent.  These are fast
// approximations for mixing decisions, not conformant STOI or SII values.
// A mix that delays the dialogue by more than a few milliseconds reads lower
// on `intelligibility`; delay the speech input to match.
//
// Controls
// --------
//   window_ms       [100, 3000]  analysis window
//   threshold_db    [-80, -20]   speech level below which analysis holds
//   speech_gain_db  [-24, 24]    dialogue level in the mix relative to `speech`
//
// Meters
// ------
//   intelligibility  [0, 1]   importance-weighted envelope correlation
//   audibility       [0, 1]   importance-weighted band audibility
//   rating           bad / poor / fair / good / excellent (edges 0.3, 0.45, 0.6, 0.75)
//   snr_db           speech-to-noise ratio across the analyzed bands
//   speech_db, mix_db  input levels, dBFS RMS
//   speech_active    the gate state
//
// Visualizer: "intelligibility_viz" - per-band levels and scores, the two
// summary meters, the rating and a score history.
//
// Usage (after crag.include):
//   %out = crag.subgraph_ref "intelligibility_analyzer"(%speech, %mix)
//              : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>) -> !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>

module {
  crag.include_visualizer "analysis/intelligibility_analyzer-viz.crag.mlir"
      as "intelligibility_viz"

  crag.graph name = "intelligibility_analyzer" sample_rate = 0 channels = 1
      default_visualizer = "intelligibility_viz" {
  ^bb0(%speech: !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, %mix: !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>):
    %window_ms = crag.param "window_ms" min = 100.0 max = 3000.0 default = 400.0 unit = "ms" : f32
    %thr_db    = crag.param "threshold_db" min = -80.0 max = -20.0 default = -50.0 unit = "dB" : f32
    %sgain_db  = crag.param "speech_gain_db" min = -24.0 max = 24.0 default = 0.0 unit = "dB" : f32

    %sr     = crag.sample_rate : f32
    %blk_i  = crag.block_size : i64
    %blk_f  = arith.sitofp %blk_i : i64 to f32
    %c0     = arith.constant 0.0 : f32
    %c1     = arith.constant 1.0 : f32
    %c2     = arith.constant 2.0 : f32
    %half   = arith.constant 0.5 : f32
    %pi     = arith.constant 3.14159265 : f32
    %two_pi = arith.constant 6.28318531 : f32
    %tiny   = arith.constant 1.0e-12 : f32
    %c1000  = arith.constant 1000.0 : f32
    %ln10_20 = arith.constant 0.115129255 : f32
    %ln10_10 = arith.constant 0.230258509 : f32
    %db_p   = arith.constant 4.34294482 : f32
    %max_norm = arith.constant 0.9 : f32
    %nyq    = arith.mulf %sr, %half : f32
    %res_k  = arith.constant -5.609986875e-01 : f32
    %ci0 = arith.constant 0 : index
    %ci1 = arith.constant 1 : index
    %ci2 = arith.constant 2 : index
    %ci3 = arith.constant 3 : index
    %ci4 = arith.constant 4 : index
    %ci5 = arith.constant 5 : index
    %ci6 = arith.constant 6 : index
    %ci7 = arith.constant 7 : index
    %ci8 = arith.constant 8 : index
    %ci9 = arith.constant 9 : index
    %ci10 = arith.constant 10 : index
    %ci11 = arith.constant 11 : index
    %ci12 = arith.constant 12 : index
    %ci13 = arith.constant 13 : index
    %ci14 = arith.constant 14 : index
    %ci15 = arith.constant 15 : index
    %ci16 = arith.constant 16 : index
    %ci17 = arith.constant 17 : index

    // Speech gate: fast attack, 60 ms release, so the statistics cover speech
    // only and freeze through pauses.
    %sp_rms  = crag.rms %speech : !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0> -> f32
    %mx_rms  = crag.rms %mix : !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0> -> f32
    %g_atk   = arith.constant 5.0 : f32
    %g_rel   = arith.constant 60.0 : f32
    %sp_env  = crag.smooth %sp_rms, %g_atk, %g_rel : f32, f32, f32 -> f32
    %thr_ln  = arith.mulf %thr_db, %ln10_20 : f32
    %thr     = math.exp %thr_ln : f32
    %active  = arith.cmpf ogt, %sp_env, %thr : f32

    // Statistics update rate: k = 1 - exp(-block / window) while speech is
    // active, 0 (hold) otherwise.
    %win_s   = arith.mulf %window_ms, %sr : f32
    %win_n   = arith.divf %win_s, %c1000 : f32
    %ratio   = arith.divf %blk_f, %win_n : f32
    %nratio  = arith.negf %ratio : f32
    %decay   = math.exp %nratio : f32
    %k_on    = arith.subf %c1, %decay : f32
    %k       = arith.select %active, %k_on, %c0 : f32

    // Speech power in the mix = speech-input power * speech_gain^2.
    %sg_ln   = arith.mulf %sgain_db, %ln10_10 : f32
    %sg2     = math.exp %sg_ln : f32
    %snr_cap = arith.constant 1.0e-3 : f32
    %c15     = arith.constant 15.0 : f32
    %c30     = arith.constant 30.0 : f32

    // ---- band 0: 160 Hz ----
    %b0_hz = arith.constant 160.0 : f32
    %b0_n0 = arith.divf %b0_hz, %nyq : f32
    %b0_norm = arith.minimumf %b0_n0, %max_norm : f32
    %b0_fb, %b0_ff = crag.get_filter_coeffs %b0_norm order = 2 q = 2.800000000e+00 type = "two_pole_resonator" : f32, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec
    %b0_s1 = crag.filter %speech, %b0_fb, %b0_ff : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec) -> !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>
    %b0_s2 = crag.filter %b0_s1, %b0_fb, %b0_ff : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec) -> !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>
    %b0_sraw = crag.rms %b0_s2 : !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0> -> f32
    %b0_m1 = crag.filter %mix, %b0_fb, %b0_ff : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec) -> !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>
    %b0_m2 = crag.filter %b0_m1, %b0_fb, %b0_ff : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec) -> !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>
    %b0_mraw = crag.rms %b0_m2 : !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0> -> f32
    %b0_re = arith.mulf %b0_norm, %res_k : f32
    %b0_r = math.exp %b0_re : f32
    %b0_th2 = arith.mulf %b0_norm, %two_pi : f32
    %b0_cos = math.cos %b0_th2 : f32
    %b0_rc = arith.mulf %b0_r, %b0_cos : f32
    %b0_rc2 = arith.mulf %b0_rc, %c2 : f32
    %b0_rr = arith.mulf %b0_r, %b0_r : f32
    %b0_d0 = arith.subf %c1, %b0_rc2 : f32
    %b0_d1 = arith.addf %b0_d0, %b0_rr : f32
    %b0_d2 = math.sqrt %b0_d1 : f32
    %b0_omr = arith.subf %c1, %b0_r : f32
    %b0_g1 = arith.mulf %b0_omr, %b0_d2 : f32
    %b0_g = arith.mulf %b0_g1, %b0_g1 : f32
    %b0_s = arith.mulf %b0_sraw, %b0_g : f32
    %b0_m = arith.mulf %b0_mraw, %b0_g : f32
    %b0_ss = arith.mulf %b0_s, %b0_s : f32
    %b0_mm = arith.mulf %b0_m, %b0_m : f32
    %b0_sm = arith.mulf %b0_s, %b0_m : f32
    %b0_es0 = crag.line_load %ci0 group = "intelligibility" slot = 0 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b0_esd = arith.subf %b0_s, %b0_es0 : f32
    %b0_esk = arith.mulf %b0_esd, %k : f32
    %b0_es = arith.addf %b0_es0, %b0_esk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci0, %b0_es group = "intelligibility" slot = 0 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b0_em0 = crag.line_load %ci0 group = "intelligibility" slot = 1 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b0_emd = arith.subf %b0_m, %b0_em0 : f32
    %b0_emk = arith.mulf %b0_emd, %k : f32
    %b0_em = arith.addf %b0_em0, %b0_emk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci0, %b0_em group = "intelligibility" slot = 1 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b0_ess0 = crag.line_load %ci0 group = "intelligibility" slot = 2 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b0_essd = arith.subf %b0_ss, %b0_ess0 : f32
    %b0_essk = arith.mulf %b0_essd, %k : f32
    %b0_ess = arith.addf %b0_ess0, %b0_essk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci0, %b0_ess group = "intelligibility" slot = 2 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b0_emm0 = crag.line_load %ci0 group = "intelligibility" slot = 3 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b0_emmd = arith.subf %b0_mm, %b0_emm0 : f32
    %b0_emmk = arith.mulf %b0_emmd, %k : f32
    %b0_emm = arith.addf %b0_emm0, %b0_emmk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci0, %b0_emm group = "intelligibility" slot = 3 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b0_esm0 = crag.line_load %ci0 group = "intelligibility" slot = 4 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b0_esmd = arith.subf %b0_sm, %b0_esm0 : f32
    %b0_esmk = arith.mulf %b0_esmd, %k : f32
    %b0_esm = arith.addf %b0_esm0, %b0_esmk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci0, %b0_esm group = "intelligibility" slot = 4 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b0_mu = arith.mulf %b0_es, %b0_em : f32
    %b0_cov = arith.subf %b0_esm, %b0_mu : f32
    %b0_es2 = arith.mulf %b0_es, %b0_es : f32
    %b0_em2 = arith.mulf %b0_em, %b0_em : f32
    %b0_vs0 = arith.subf %b0_ess, %b0_es2 : f32
    %b0_vm0 = arith.subf %b0_emm, %b0_em2 : f32
    %b0_vs = arith.maximumf %b0_vs0, %c0 : f32
    %b0_vm = arith.maximumf %b0_vm0, %c0 : f32
    %b0_vv = arith.mulf %b0_vs, %b0_vm : f32
    %b0_sd = math.sqrt %b0_vv : f32
    %b0_den = arith.addf %b0_sd, %tiny : f32
    %b0_c0 = arith.divf %b0_cov, %b0_den : f32
    %b0_c1 = arith.maximumf %b0_c0, %c0 : f32
    %b0_corr = arith.minimumf %b0_c1, %c1 : f32
    crag.line_store %ci0, %b0_corr group = "intelligibility" slot = 5 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b0_ps = arith.mulf %b0_ess, %sg2 : f32
    %b0_nz0 = arith.subf %b0_emm, %b0_ps : f32
    %b0_fl0 = arith.mulf %b0_ps, %snr_cap : f32
    %b0_fl = arith.addf %b0_fl0, %tiny : f32
    %b0_nz = arith.maximumf %b0_nz0, %b0_fl : f32
    %b0_psf = arith.addf %b0_ps, %tiny : f32
    %b0_rat = arith.divf %b0_psf, %b0_nz : f32
    %b0_rln = math.log %b0_rat : f32
    %b0_snr = arith.mulf %b0_rln, %db_p : f32
    %b0_a0 = arith.addf %b0_snr, %c15 : f32
    %b0_a1 = arith.divf %b0_a0, %c30 : f32
    %b0_a2 = arith.maximumf %b0_a1, %c0 : f32
    %b0_aud = arith.minimumf %b0_a2, %c1 : f32
    crag.line_store %ci0, %b0_aud group = "intelligibility" slot = 6 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b0_sp = arith.addf %b0_ess, %tiny : f32
    %b0_sl = math.log %b0_sp : f32
    %b0_sdb = arith.mulf %b0_sl, %db_p : f32
    crag.line_store %ci0, %b0_sdb group = "intelligibility" slot = 7 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b0_mp = arith.addf %b0_emm, %tiny : f32
    %b0_ml = math.log %b0_mp : f32
    %b0_mdb = arith.mulf %b0_ml, %db_p : f32
    crag.line_store %ci0, %b0_mdb group = "intelligibility" slot = 8 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b0_w = arith.constant 8.300000000e-03 : f32
    %b0_wc = arith.mulf %b0_corr, %b0_w : f32
    %b0_wa = arith.mulf %b0_aud, %b0_w : f32
    %b0_score = arith.addf %c0, %b0_wc : f32
    %b0_audt = arith.addf %c0, %b0_wa : f32
    %b0_pst = arith.addf %c0, %b0_ps : f32
    %b0_nzt = arith.addf %c0, %b0_nz : f32

    // ---- band 1: 200 Hz ----
    %b1_hz = arith.constant 200.0 : f32
    %b1_n0 = arith.divf %b1_hz, %nyq : f32
    %b1_norm = arith.minimumf %b1_n0, %max_norm : f32
    %b1_fb, %b1_ff = crag.get_filter_coeffs %b1_norm order = 2 q = 2.800000000e+00 type = "two_pole_resonator" : f32, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec
    %b1_s1 = crag.filter %speech, %b1_fb, %b1_ff : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec) -> !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>
    %b1_s2 = crag.filter %b1_s1, %b1_fb, %b1_ff : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec) -> !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>
    %b1_sraw = crag.rms %b1_s2 : !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0> -> f32
    %b1_m1 = crag.filter %mix, %b1_fb, %b1_ff : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec) -> !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>
    %b1_m2 = crag.filter %b1_m1, %b1_fb, %b1_ff : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>, !crag.coeff_vec, !crag.coeff_vec) -> !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>
    %b1_mraw = crag.rms %b1_m2 : !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0> -> f32
    %b1_re = arith.mulf %b1_norm, %res_k : f32
    %b1_r = math.exp %b1_re : f32
    %b1_th2 = arith.mulf %b1_norm, %two_pi : f32
    %b1_cos = math.cos %b1_th2 : f32
    %b1_rc = arith.mulf %b1_r, %b1_cos : f32
    %b1_rc2 = arith.mulf %b1_rc, %c2 : f32
    %b1_rr = arith.mulf %b1_r, %b1_r : f32
    %b1_d0 = arith.subf %c1, %b1_rc2 : f32
    %b1_d1 = arith.addf %b1_d0, %b1_rr : f32
    %b1_d2 = math.sqrt %b1_d1 : f32
    %b1_omr = arith.subf %c1, %b1_r : f32
    %b1_g1 = arith.mulf %b1_omr, %b1_d2 : f32
    %b1_g = arith.mulf %b1_g1, %b1_g1 : f32
    %b1_s = arith.mulf %b1_sraw, %b1_g : f32
    %b1_m = arith.mulf %b1_mraw, %b1_g : f32
    %b1_ss = arith.mulf %b1_s, %b1_s : f32
    %b1_mm = arith.mulf %b1_m, %b1_m : f32
    %b1_sm = arith.mulf %b1_s, %b1_m : f32
    %b1_es0 = crag.line_load %ci1 group = "intelligibility" slot = 0 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b1_esd = arith.subf %b1_s, %b1_es0 : f32
    %b1_esk = arith.mulf %b1_esd, %k : f32
    %b1_es = arith.addf %b1_es0, %b1_esk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b1_es group = "intelligibility" slot = 0 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b1_em0 = crag.line_load %ci1 group = "intelligibility" slot = 1 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b1_emd = arith.subf %b1_m, %b1_em0 : f32
    %b1_emk = arith.mulf %b1_emd, %k : f32
    %b1_em = arith.addf %b1_em0, %b1_emk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b1_em group = "intelligibility" slot = 1 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b1_ess0 = crag.line_load %ci1 group = "intelligibility" slot = 2 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b1_essd = arith.subf %b1_ss, %b1_ess0 : f32
    %b1_essk = arith.mulf %b1_essd, %k : f32
    %b1_ess = arith.addf %b1_ess0, %b1_essk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b1_ess group = "intelligibility" slot = 2 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b1_emm0 = crag.line_load %ci1 group = "intelligibility" slot = 3 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b1_emmd = arith.subf %b1_mm, %b1_emm0 : f32
    %b1_emmk = arith.mulf %b1_emmd, %k : f32
    %b1_emm = arith.addf %b1_emm0, %b1_emmk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b1_emm group = "intelligibility" slot = 3 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b1_esm0 = crag.line_load %ci1 group = "intelligibility" slot = 4 lines = 18 : index -> f32
    %b1_esmd = arith.subf %b1_sm, %b1_esm0 : f32
    %b1_esmk = arith.mulf %b1_esmd, %k : f32
    %b1_esm = arith.addf %b1_esm0, %b1_esmk : f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b1_esm group = "intelligibility" slot = 4 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b1_mu = arith.mulf %b1_es, %b1_em : f32
    %b1_cov = arith.subf %b1_esm, %b1_mu : f32
    %b1_es2 = arith.mulf %b1_es, %b1_es : f32
    %b1_em2 = arith.mulf %b1_em, %b1_em : f32
    %b1_vs0 = arith.subf %b1_ess, %b1_es2 : f32
    %b1_vm0 = arith.subf %b1_emm, %b1_em2 : f32
    %b1_vs = arith.maximumf %b1_vs0, %c0 : f32
    %b1_vm = arith.maximumf %b1_vm0, %c0 : f32
    %b1_vv = arith.mulf %b1_vs, %b1_vm : f32
    %b1_sd = math.sqrt %b1_vv : f32
    %b1_den = arith.addf %b1_sd, %tiny : f32
    %b1_c0 = arith.divf %b1_cov, %b1_den : f32
    %b1_c1 = arith.maximumf %b1_c0, %c0 : f32
    %b1_corr = arith.minimumf %b1_c1, %c1 : f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b1_corr group = "intelligibility" slot = 5 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b1_ps = arith.mulf %b1_ess, %sg2 : f32
    %b1_nz0 = arith.subf %b1_emm, %b1_ps : f32
    %b1_fl0 = arith.mulf %b1_ps, %snr_cap : f32
    %b1_fl = arith.addf %b1_fl0, %tiny : f32
    %b1_nz = arith.maximumf %b1_nz0, %b1_fl : f32
    %b1_psf = arith.addf %b1_ps, %tiny : f32
    %b1_rat = arith.divf %b1_psf, %b1_nz : f32
    %b1_rln = math.log %b1_rat : f32
    %b1_snr = arith.mulf %b1_rln, %db_p : f32
    %b1_a0 = arith.addf %b1_snr, %c15 : f32
    %b1_a1 = arith.divf %b1_a0, %c30 : f32
    %b1_a2 = arith.maximumf %b1_a1, %c0 : f32
    %b1_aud = arith.minimumf %b1_a2, %c1 : f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b1_aud group = "intelligibility" slot = 6 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b1_sp = arith.addf %b1_ess, %tiny : f32
    %b1_sl = math.log %b1_sp : f32
    %b1_sdb = arith.mulf %b1_sl, %db_p : f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b1_sdb group = "intelligibility" slot = 7 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b1_mp = arith.addf %b1_emm, %tiny : f32
    %b1_ml = math.log %b1_mp : f32
    %b1_mdb = arith.mulf %b1_ml, %db_p : f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b1_mdb group = "intelligibility" slot = 8 lines = 18 : index, f32

    %b17_nz = arith.maximumf %b17_nz0, %b17_fl : f32
    %b17_psf = arith.addf %b17_ps, %tiny : f32
    %b17_rat = arith.divf %b17_psf, %b17_nz : f32
    %b17_rln = math.log %b17_rat : f32
    %b17_snr = arith.mulf %b17_rln, %db_p : f32
    %b17_a0 = arith.addf %b17_snr, %c15 : f32
    %b17_a1 = arith.divf %b17_a0, %c30 : f32
    %b17_a2 = arith.maximumf %b17_a1, %c0 : f32
    %b17_aud = arith.minimumf %b17_a2, %c1 : f32
    crag.line_store %ci17, %b17_aud group = "intelligibility" slot = 6 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b17_sp = arith.addf %b17_ess, %tiny : f32
    %b17_sl = math.log %b17_sp : f32
    %b17_sdb = arith.mulf %b17_sl, %db_p : f32
    crag.line_store %ci17, %b17_sdb group = "intelligibility" slot = 7 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b17_mp = arith.addf %b17_emm, %tiny : f32
    %b17_ml = math.log %b17_mp : f32
    %b17_mdb = arith.mulf %b17_ml, %db_p : f32
    crag.line_store %ci17, %b17_mdb group = "intelligibility" slot = 8 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %b17_w = arith.constant 1.850000000e-02 : f32
    %b17_wc = arith.mulf %b17_corr, %b17_w : f32
    %b17_wa = arith.mulf %b17_aud, %b17_w : f32
    %b17_score = arith.addf %b16_score, %b17_wc : f32
    %b17_audt = arith.addf %b16_audt, %b17_wa : f32
    %b17_pst = arith.addf %b16_pst, %b17_ps : f32
    %b17_nzt = arith.addf %b16_nzt, %b17_nz : f32

    // ---- broadband summary ----
    %ps_f    = arith.addf %b17_pst, %tiny : f32
    %nz_f    = arith.addf %b17_nzt, %tiny : f32
    %snr_rat = arith.divf %ps_f, %nz_f : f32
    %snr_ln  = math.log %snr_rat : f32
    %snr_db  = arith.mulf %snr_ln, %db_p : f32
    %l_atk   = arith.constant 50.0 : f32
    %l_rel   = arith.constant 300.0 : f32
    %sp_lvl  = crag.smooth %sp_rms, %l_atk, %l_rel : f32, f32, f32 -> f32
    %mx_lvl  = crag.smooth %mx_rms, %l_atk, %l_rel : f32, f32, f32 -> f32
    %lvl_fl  = arith.constant 1.0e-5 : f32
    %db_a    = arith.constant 8.68588964 : f32
    %sp_l0   = arith.maximumf %sp_lvl, %lvl_fl : f32
    %mx_l0   = arith.maximumf %mx_lvl, %lvl_fl : f32
    %sp_l1   = math.log %sp_l0 : f32
    %mx_l1   = math.log %mx_l0 : f32
    %sp_db   = arith.mulf %sp_l1, %db_a : f32
    %mx_db   = arith.mulf %mx_l1, %db_a : f32
    %act_f   = arith.select %active, %c1, %c0 : f32

    crag.line_store %ci0, %b17_score group = "intelligibility" slot = 9 lines = 18 : index, f32
    crag.line_store %ci1, %b17_audt group = "intelligibility" slot = 9 lines = 18 : index, f32
    crag.line_store %ci2, %act_f group = "intelligibility" slot = 9 lines = 18 : index, f32
    crag.line_store %ci3, %snr_db group = "intelligibility" slot = 9 lines = 18 : index, f32
    crag.line_store %ci4, %sp_db group = "intelligibility" slot = 9 lines = 18 : index, f32
    crag.line_store %ci5, %mx_db group = "intelligibility" slot = 9 lines = 18 : index, f32
    %r_0 = arith.constant 0 : i32
    %r_one = arith.constant 1 : i32
    %r_e0 = arith.constant 3.000000000e-01 : f32
    %r_c0 = arith.cmpf oge, %b17_score, %r_e0 : f32
    %r_s0 = arith.select %r_c0, %r_one, %r_0 : i32
    %r_a0 = arith.addi %r_0, %r_s0 : i32
    %r_e1 = arith.constant 4.500000000e-01 : f32
    %r_c1 = arith.cmpf oge, %b17_score, %r_e1 : f32
    %r_s1 = arith.select %r_c1, %r_one, %r_0 : i32
    %r_a1 = arith.addi %r_a0, %r_s1 : i32
    %r_e2 = arith.constant 6.000000000e-01 : f32
    %r_c2 = arith.cmpf oge, %b17_score, %r_e2 : f32
    %r_s2 = arith.select %r_c2, %r_one, %r_0 : i32
    %r_a2 = arith.addi %r_a1, %r_s2 : i32
    %r_e3 = arith.constant 7.500000000e-01 : f32
    %r_c3 = arith.cmpf oge, %b17_score, %r_e3 : f32
    %r_s3 = arith.select %r_c3, %r_one, %r_0 : i32
    %r_a3 = arith.addi %r_a2, %r_s3 : i32

    crag.meter "intelligibility" %b17_score min = 0.0 max = 1.0 : f32
    crag.meter "audibility" %b17_audt min = 0.0 max = 1.0 : f32
    crag.meter_enum "rating" %r_a3 values = ["bad", "poor", "fair", "good", "excellent"] : i32
    crag.meter "snr_db" %snr_db min = -15.0 max = 30.0 unit = "dB" : f32
    crag.meter "speech_db" %sp_db min = -100.0 max = 0.0 unit = "dB" : f32
    crag.meter "mix_db" %mx_db min = -100.0 max = 0.0 unit = "dB" : f32
    crag.meter_bool "speech_active" %active : i1

    crag.visualizer_ref "intelligibility_viz"(%mix) : (!crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>)
    crag.output %mix : !crag.audio<f32, 0, 0>
  }
